purpose: Versioned comparison registry for waveform, ringdown, and numerical-relativity surrogates. Reported numbers are literature claims and are not Symtropy results.
comparison_rules: Never compare mismatch numbers unless waveform modes, parameter domain, total-mass range, frequency band, detector weighting, reference waveform, and alignment procedure match.
Separate waveform mismatch from parameter-estimation speedup and batch throughput.
Record hardware, batch size, precision, software version, and warm-up policy for all performance comparisons.
Preserve model applicability domains and out-of-domain behavior; do not infer extrapolation capability from interpolation validation.
Pin exact paper version, source code commit, data release, and supplementary validation tables before numerical reproduction.

baselines.implementation: JAX; differentiable waveform and likelihood pipeline
baselines.comparability: Paper-reported domain/hardware; not directly comparable to unrelated q or spin domains.

reported_accuracy.metric: QNM-fit remnant parameter recovery versus NRSur7dq4

baselines.implementation: gwsurrogate; overlapping inspiral and merger-ringdown temporal domains
baselines.comparability: 3-10x refers to remnant mass/spin estimates, not a universal waveform mismatch improvement.
Pin the published hardware, masses, training domain, and exact inference runs before reproducing.

reported_performance.template_bank_generation: millions of waveforms in under one second

baselines.comparability: Exact parameter domain and benchmark hardware should be extracted from the paper before direct comparison.

baselines.implementation: radial-phase inspiral compression plus time-domain merger-ringdown surrogate
baselines.comparability: Eccentric nonspinning domain is distinct from generic precessing quasicircular models.

reported_accuracy.comparison: reported accuracy comparable to calibrated EOB and NR surrogate models
reported_accuracy.sparse_catalog_regions: reported useful accuracy in regions sparsely covered by NR

baselines.comparability: Different model class from a full inspiral waveform surrogate; especially relevant to merger-ringdown and direct-wave / News-frequency discrimination.

reported_accuracy.finding: targeted resolution/domain choices reduce constraint and waveform differences; floating-point error and disparate variable scales limit further high-resolution accuracy

baselines.comparability: Motivates nondimensionalization, scale-aware precision, and non-monotonic resolution studies.

domain.systems: generic-orbit, spin-precessing binary black holes; inspiral-merger-ringdown, dynamical capture and scattering
domain.eccentricity: generic orbital configurations; not restricted to quasicircular inspirals

baselines.implementation: SEOBNRv6EPHM effective-one-body waveform model; not a neural surrogate
baselines.comparability: Broadens the reference set to generic-orbit / eccentric precessing systems. Preserve the paper's waveform domain and NR validation split; mismatch values are not directly comparable to frequency-domain surrogate mismatches for different modes/domains.

domain.eccentricity: up to approximately 0.9, with cited high-eccentricity comparisons at 14 periastron passages before merger

baselines.implementation: time-domain multipolar effective-one-body waveform model, not a neural surrogate
baselines.comparability: Distinct from generic spin-precessing SEOBNRv6EPHM and from neural reduced-order surrogates. Preserve its planar-orbit, eccentricity, modes, mass range, and SXS comparison domain.

findings.eccentricity_support_threshold: log10 Bayes factor > 0.5 against quasi-circular precessing-spin hypothesis
findings.caveat: Recovered unbound configurations are astrophysically unrealistic and not confidently distinguishable from highly eccentric bound orbits; these results do not alone establish an unbound origin.

baselines.comparability: This is a PE/systematics study using SEOBNRv6EHM, not an independent waveform family or a direct waveform-mismatch benchmark. Keep its astrophysical interpretation caveats.

required_features: held-out splits by simulation family/configuration, not random neighboring parameter points
calibrated waveform error distributions including tails
cross-model disagreement as an uncertainty and active-learning signal
propagation of model discrepancy into posterior coverage
active selection of the next expensive NR simulation
comparison with random and space-filling acquisition at equal simulation budget
symtropy_differentiator.success_claim_ceiling: bounded, independently validated surrogate with calibrated applicability and uncertainty; no universal SOTA claim

newest_sota_notes: SEOBNRv6EHM was published in PRD on 2026-11-03 (DOI 10.1103/shbg-989s). The final paper validates 592 quasi-circular, 319 eccentric, 1 capture and 2 scattering SXS waveforms; for high eccentricity it reports mismatches below/near 2% up to e~0.9 at 14 periastron passages before merger and 2-8x speedup over other state-of-the-art EOB eccentric models.

The companion SEOBNRv6EHM catalogue PE/systematics study (DOI 10.1103/cx64-gmkk, published 2026-11-03) analyzed 27 O1-O4 events, finds five with mild eccentricity support, and explores unbound configurations in five high-mass events. Three have comparable/marginally favored unbound fits, but the recovered configurations are astrophysically unrealistic and not confidently separable from high-eccentricity bound orbits.
Do not collapse waveform-generation speedup, parameter-estimation speedup, mismatch, and Bayesian evidence into one performance figure.
